hero.title: Diamond saw blades,
hero.lead: Sintered, laser-welded and vacuum-brazed rims for tile, stone, concrete and asphalt. Built for the machines used in Europe, India, Central Asia and the Middle East.

markets.title: Same factory. Four kinds of cut.
markets.europeBody: Millimetre sizes for professional tile, stone and concrete work. Laser-welded segments for cured and reinforced concrete. The brochure cites ISO 9001:2000 and German MPA safety and quality certification.
markets.indiaBody: Angle-grinder diameters for vitrified tile, and a heavier turbo or segmented rim when the job moves to granite. Hand tools from 105 mm, with larger blades for stone yards.
markets.centralAsiaBody: Floor saws and cut-off saws in concrete, rebar and asphalt. Segmented blades for road and structural cuts, including wall-saw blades.
markets.middleEastBody: Marble and granite on site, often cut dry and in heat. Thin turbo rims for a clean stone edge, and vacuum-brazed blades when the cut has to stay fast.

materials.title: Start from the material.
materials.intro: The catalog is a saw-blade list first. Cup wheels and core bits sit behind it, for the same job.
materials.tileBody: Continuous rim and thin turbo blades for a narrow kerf on tile.
materials.stoneBody: Turbo and segmented rims for granite, marble and stone.
materials.generalBody: Sintered and vacuum-brazed blades when one rim has to cover mixed materials.
materials.concreteBody: Cured, green and reinforced concrete, plus wall-saw blades.
materials.asphaltBody: Blades for asphalt, green concrete and other abrasive cuts.
materials.tuckBody: Concave blades for joints, cracks and sink cut-outs.

process.title: Three bonds in the catalog.
process.sinteredBody: Continuous, turbo and segmented blades for tile, stone and general cutting.
process.laserBody: Laser-welded segments for fast concrete cutting and harder job-site work.
process.brazedBody: A single layer of diamond, for fast cutting across mixed materials.

companion.title: After the blade.
companion.cupBody: Turbo, single-row, double-row and shaped cup wheels for surface grinding.
companion.coreBody: Core bits and sets, including laser-welded and vacuum-brazed bits.

factory.title: The blades are made here.
factory.body: Danyang I Believe Machinery Tools Co., Ltd. has produced diamond tools in the Danyang Economic Development Zone since 2014. The factory covers 3,000 m². The brochure states an annual capacity of more than 2 million pieces, and cites ISO 9001:2000 plus German MPA safety and quality certification.

faq.title: Before you enquire
faq.a1: Diamond saw blades first: tile, stone, concrete, asphalt and tuck-point blades, in sintered, laser-welded and vacuum-brazed bonds. Cup wheels and core bits are included as matching tools.
faq.a2: Danyang Economic Development Zone, Jiangsu Province, China.
